plan: DUMMIE PLAN V1 — Cognitive Evolution Operating Layer

claims: Deterministic freshness + stale detection reduces blind reuse of outdated derived artifacts.
Context packaging + receipts makes context selection reproducible and auditable.
Value-per-token scoring creates measurable selection pressure toward useful compact context.
objections: Folder-note hash for large volatile folders can become stale quickly without automated cadence.
Current scorer is deterministic heuristic, not adaptive to model-specific utility curves.
decisions: Implement P10-P13 as one runtime bundle in l2_brain to reduce meta-overhead.
Keep runtime integration safe and optional; no daemon hard-wiring yet.
Write latest context artifacts to .aiwg/reports for immediate operational visibility.
risks: Heuristic thresholds may need tuning after real mission telemetry.
Missing world model or coverage inputs degrade decision quality and produce warnings.
Legacy specs debt remains unresolved and isolated as inherited warning.

snowball_assessment.reason: Bundle introduces executable context-runtime capabilities with tests and reproducible outputs.

warnings: One stale folder-note hash finding remains and is now detectable by runtime.
